infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Reprummble needs camera access to scan your meals and track your workout form.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Reprummble needs photo library access to select meal photos for nutrition analysis.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Reprummble uses your location to tag posts with where you are.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Reprummble to access your camera for meal scanning and workout tracking.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Reprummble to access your photos for meal analysis.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Reprummble to access your camera to take photos for your status and posts.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Reprummble to use your location to tag posts with your current location.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Reprummble reads your steps, workouts, heart rate, HRV, sleep, and body measurements from Apple Health to build your training plan and daily recovery score.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Reprummble can save workouts you log in the app to Apple Health.
